name: Verified active registry coverage
numerator_definition: Expected in-scope sites with a verified active registry record at period end.
denominator_definition: All sites in the approved expected-site inventory at period end, including sites not registered.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: No approved expected-site inventory means UNKNOWN. Registered sites alone cannot form both components. Count facility sites, not owners; do not sum across months. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Expected-site inventory and verified registry records

name: Corrective actions completed by deadline
numerator_definition: Corrective actions due in the period with independently accepted completion no later than deadline.
denominator_definition: All corrective actions due in the period, including overdue and nonresponding sites.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Keep severity and criteria versions in the supporting evidence. Self-attested completion and an expired obligation are not accepted corrective closure. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Affiliation corrective-action due dates and independent acceptance

name: Affiliation renewal decisions made in time
numerator_definition: Prior affiliation decisions expiring in the period with the renewal decision recorded before the prior expiry.
denominator_definition: All prior affiliation decisions due to expire in the period, including expired and nonresponding sites.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Do not infer renewal from registration or a pending application; do not remove expired sites to improve the proportion. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Prior decision expiry and actual renewal-decision timestamps

name: Regional interventions completed by deadline
numerator_definition: Accepted regional coordination interventions due in the period with independently accepted completion by deadline.
denominator_definition: All accepted regional coordination interventions due in the period, including blocked and overdue work.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude zone-delivered interventions already counted in the zone stream. Completion requires evidence and independent acceptance; funding alone is not fulfilment. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Regional commitments, due dates and independent completion reviews
